messages:
Priya: Quick postmortem follow-up from the regional TLS fanout incident — I captured the action items from the call, assigning owners and proposed timelines. Posting here so we have a single place to track.

Priya: Symptoms recap: inter-region traffic fanout caused asymmetric TLS handshakes and high retry rates on LBs for ~18m, spike in 5xxs for customers in eu-west and us-west. Root cause: routing policy mismatch + stale cert rotation path for a subset of edge nodes.

Priya: Action items: 
- Diego -> confirm which AZs still use legacy cert path and add fallback route (ETA: 2024-11-07)
- Ashley -> add an automated smoke check for TLS handshake regression in staging + alert runbook (ETA: 2024-11-05)
- Kevin -> roll forward new routing policy with canary config and 15m watch (ETA: 2024-11-06)
- Lisa -> own post-deploy QA and add prompt eval for cross-region latency (ETA: 2024-11-06)

Priya: Diego and Ashley, please comment below if timelines need adjustment. I'm putting a 2-week window for full verification and retro. :calendar:

Diego: ack. I'll start with an inventory query to find the legacy certs. Posting the command I used: ```bash
/opt/tools/cert-inventory --region all --output csv | grep legacy-path
```
Diego: If I find >3 nodes with legacy path, I want a hotfix plan rather than rolling policy change.

Ashley: ack. I'll add the TLS smoke test to the deploy pipeline and wire an alert (pager + slack) if handshake RTT > 400ms or retry rate > 3% for 5m.

Kevin: For canary, propose: 5% traffic to new routing policy in eu-west for 30m, then 20% in us-west if green. If we see >1% retry delta, auto-rollback. Thoughts?

Priya: That canary sounds reasonable. Add a dashboard tile for 'retry delta vs baseline' and a synthetic hitting the same customer path.

sre-oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall shift change at 2024-11-03 07:00 UTC. Attach incident runbook: <https://redwood/internal/runbooks/tls-fanout>.

Lisa: I'll prep the QA checklist. Quick note: we should validate both QUIC and TCP handshakes since customers may see different behavior.

Diego: inventory run done — 4 nodes in us-west-2 still using legacy path. Filing a hotfix PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/PR-4521 (assigning Kevin for rollout).

Ashley: Smoke test PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/PR-4524. It adds a job to staging CI that hits cross-region proxy endpoints and fails if handshake retry > 1% over 5 runs.

Priya: Good progress. I'll update the postmortem doc with these owners + link to PRs. Next sync: 2024-11-05 16:00 UTC in #incidents — 10m check-in to confirm rollouts. If anyone can't make it, drop status here.

Kevin: Timed canary approved. I'll coordinate with Diego for the hotfix rollout window (target 2024-11-06 02:00 UTC).

Lisa: QA will run pre-canary checks and a quick smoke after 30m. If anything suspicious, I'll post evidence (pcaps, traces) in this thread.

Priya: Thanks team. Filing follow-ups as issues in the tracker and tagging infra + routing. Closing the loop here for now :white_check_mark:

Ashley: One more ask — can we add an annotation to the config that indicates last cert-rotation timestamp? Would help avoid this blindspot later.

Diego: Good idea. I'll add a field to our inventory export.

Kevin: I'll add the annotation as part of the canary rollout.

sre-oncall-bot: Note: postmortem doc updated at 2024-11-03T15:20Z by Priya. Link: <https://redwood/internal/postmortems/pm-tls-fanout-2046009876>
